fact: American Physical Society — nonprofit scientific society, Jak's employer
2026 strategic portfolio: 42 initiatives across 5 value propositions (Enterprise Resilience, Knowledge Creation, Culture & Talent, Professional Experience, Advocacy)
IS department is most heavily depended upon shared service (31 initiative references across the strategic portfolio)
Publications processes ~48,000 manuscripts annually via PRISM
Senior Leadership Team (SLT) is the body of chiefs: CFO/COO, Chief HR Officer, Chief External Affairs Officer, Chief Marketing Officer, Chief Publications Officer, and others
Core Management Team (CMT) is the body of directors and department heads — functional leaders across the organization
Departments include editorial, sales, EPPMO, international affairs, information systems, human resources, governance, marketing, finance, membership, publications, and strategic communications
All Staff meetings are APS-wide meetings with all staff. All Minds is an IS department-specific staff meeting. These are separate from the Annual Leadership Meeting (ALM), which is a broader event.

Organizational culture exhibits significant skepticism about AI adoption — concerns include job displacement, environmental impact, ethics, copyright, and whether AI improves outcomes. Senior leadership conservative on AI rollout.
Organizational value streams mapped (document: Value Streams @ APS by Kimi, July 2025)
Brand palette: Brand Blue (#00538B), Brand Teal (#00B4D8), Purple (#1F1C6B), Orange (#FF8F1C); typography: Jost (sans-serif) and Faustina (serif)
No meeting transcript intelligence tools (Fathom or equivalent) in use. Meetings documented through shared Google Docs with running agendas.
Established vendor RFI/RFP evaluation process used across multiple projects (PWT in 2025-2026, CDP in 2024)
